title: Moving beyond harm. A critical review of how NLP research approaches discrimination
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss religion, faith, or religious bias. Its focus is on the general framing of discrimination within NLP research, arguing for a shift from a 'harm' and 'bias' based vocabulary to one centered on 'injustice'.
